metadata.description: Solanaut's office: seven seats, vendored from the Office pattern. A seat is a write boundary.

plugins.name: solanaut-architect
plugins.description: Designs the AI system before anything is built: agent topology, context strategy, model choice, and the ADR that records why.

plugins.name: solanaut-harness
plugins.description: Owns the agent's own environment — skills, agents, commands, hooks, MCP wiring and CLAUDE.md files — and audits them as a system.

plugins.name: solanaut-builder
plugins.description: Implements against an accepted design. Writes source, refactors, and makes the code read like the code around it.

plugins.name: solanaut-integrator
plugins.description: Owns the public surface: SDK and API design, versioning, packaging, and the docs a consumer outside the repo actually needs.

plugins.name: solanaut-evaluator
plugins.description: Writes and runs the test battery, then reports failures as specific edits for another seat to make. Cannot edit what it finds.

plugins.name: solanaut-operator
plugins.description: CI, containers, release preparation and deploy readiness. Proves it comes up clean on a machine that is not this one.

plugins.name: solanaut-archivist
plugins.description: Keeps runs/, PROGRESS.md and kb/ current, and enforces provenance on anything measured: version, config, run ID.
